en.AnySearch API key (configured): AnySearch API key (optional, free anonymous without; key raises quota)
en.billedHint: Model-based search (OpenAI/Gemini/Claude): billed per call, runs only when explicitly selected, never in automatic fallback.
en.bingMarketHint: Bing's mkt + Accept-Language follow this. e.g. ru-RU returns Russian results for Cyrillic queries.
en.blockedDomainsHint: One domain per line. A matched site and all of its subdomains are dropped from search results (csdn.net covers blog.csdn.net). Leave empty to disable. Full URLs are accepted — scheme, path and port are stripped automatically.
en.blockedDomainsWarn: Ignored ${dupes} duplicate(s) and ${dropped} unrecognized line(s); corrected ${corrected} line(s) to bare domains. Rules apply to the next search, and the result cache is invalidated accordingly.
en.cacheTtlHint: 0 disables caching, max 5 minutes. Lower = fresher results, higher = less rate-limiting / fewer credits used.
en.Claude key (configured): Anthropic key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, billed per search, explicit use only)
en.description: Free web search — no API key needed (Bing / DuckDuckGo / AnySearch / Exa / Tavily / Keenable / Firecrawl / Parallel / You.com)
en.Doubao search key (configured): Doubao / Volcano Web Search key (DOUBAO_SEARCH_API_KEY, 500 free/month)
en.engineEnableHint: Unchecked engines are excluded globally from web_search fallback, Auto routing, advanced_search, multi_search, and engine tests. At least one engine must remain enabled.
en.engineHint: Multi Search queries every enabled engine of the query's language pool concurrently and merges/deduplicates results (zh/en pools editable below, minimum 2 engines each). Auto smartly routes a single engine by query language and time filter. API KEY engines need credentials below.
en.fallbackOnHint: Choose which failure classes may trigger a fallback to the next engine. All checked = current behaviour (search never fails outright); unchecking one means such a failure stops the search and surfaces that engine's error instead of trying another engine. Missing keys, disabled engines and unsupported time filters are not failures and always advance.
en.fallbackPriorityHint: Top to bottom is the fallback order. The preferred engine is still tried first. Auto keeps language/time routing, while customized priority orders engines within a route group and the remaining fallback chain. Disabled engines keep their position but are skipped.
en.fetchTakeoverHint: On: when web.fetchProvider is unset or still the factory default http, it is taken over as fs-quality-fetch. Turn this off if you deliberately pinned http (e.g. you only want the built-in fetcher).
en.Gemini key (configured): Gemini key (GEMINI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY, billed per search, explicit use only)
en.keysHint: Key resolution: .credentials.yaml credential center > here > environment variables. Recommended: store keys in the credential center (same as official LLM providers, one place for all).
en.keyStorageCredHint: Saved to ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml (highest priority). Currently configured: ${["anysearch", "exa", "tavily", "keenable", "firecrawl", "parallel", "perplexity", "serpbase", "serply", "deepseek", "youcom", "baidu", "kimi", "aliyun", "doubao", "openai", "gemini", "claude"].filter((k) => c[k]).map((k) => k.toUpperCase()).join(", ") || "none"}
en.keyStorageSettingsHint: Saved to the active profile plugin entry config (cordis.patch.yml; lower priority than the credential center).
en.languagePoolHint: The route head for Auto and the concurrent pool for Multi: picked by query language. Multi runs every engine in the pool (no longer top 3). Each pool keeps a minimum of 2 engines, no upper limit; disabled/cooling/keyless engines are skipped automatically.
en.marketAuto: Automatic — send no mkt (recommended outside the listed regions)
en.multiMaxEnginesHint: How many engines Multi may query at once. 0 = no limit (default, runs the whole language pool, same as before). This is a ceiling, not a quota: fewer candidates simply means fewer engines run.
en.multiMinSourcesHint: How many engines should ideally return results. Below target, extra engines from outside the pool are tried until it is met. This is a target, not a hard minimum: if it still cannot be met, existing results are returned and only a note is added — the search never fails for this reason.
en.multiPresetHint: One click sets the two numbers above to a common combination (Fast = 1 engine / 1 source, Balanced = 3 / 1, Deep = 6 / 2); editing them switches back to Custom. Current: ${now}.
en.OpenAI key (configured): OpenAI key (OPENAI_API_KEY, billed per search, explicit use only)
en.platformHint: Enable platforms for the agent's platform_search tool. Disabled platforms are skipped.
en.safeSearchHint: Applies to bing (adlt), ddg, ddg-lite (adlt degree). If you see the engine's own filtering, adjust here.
en.starPrompt: Leave a star — it makes the author's day
en.unavailable: Settings unavailable — the free-search bridge is not exposed.
en.updateCheckFailed: Update check failed (cannot reach npm registry)
en.updateLatest: You're on the latest version v${c}
en.upgradeDone: Upgraded to v${l} - restart dsh to apply
en.upgradeLinkMode: (local dev install - use git pull to update)
en.You.com API key (configured): You.com API key (optional, free without: 100 searches a day; YDC_API_KEY)
en.Zhihu key (configured): Zhihu key (ZHIHU_API_KEY, shared by Zhihu web-wide/site)
